verdict.rationale: Navan's developer docs show MCP and API access for querying uncoded/flagged transactions and policy violations (navan-docs-5, navan-docs-6, navan-docs-3) and API 'retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface' (navan-docs-2, navan-docs-4), which supports pulling transactions and pushing updates. However there is no explicit documentation of an agent proposing categorizations or a formal 'push clean coding back for review' workflow, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of write-back via MCP. Missing for 10: explicit categorization/coding-suggestion feature docs, evidence of a review/approval step tied to MCP writes, and third-party confirmation that the write path works as described.
